text:
noah kim: Morning all 44b I booked an Eurail ticket for client travel but the client canceled one leg and rail issued a partial refund to my card (€215). It hasn't shown up yet. I paid the original fare on my personal card and already submitted the expense. Do I need to return the reimbursed amount or will finance net it off next claim?
sarah (travel-ops): Hi Noah 44b usually refunds go back to the original card. If you already got reimbursed for the full fare, finance will either offset the refund against future expenses or request repayment. Can you attach the rail refund confirmation and the original ticket?
noah kim: uploading refund_email.pdf and ticket_qr.jpg to Expensify under "eurail-refund-0424". Email shows refund of €215; bank hasn't posted. Also wondering: because I lost one travel day, do I need to adjust my per-diem claim? I claimed full 3 days in the original expense.
expense-bot: POLICY_NOTE: Per-diem adjustments required for partial travel days. Please provide travel itinerary showing actual overnight stay dates. Refunds: finance will require proof of refund posting if reimbursed previously.
nana (finance): Small correction - I'm Ana from Finance. We'll need: 1) proof of refund posting (bank trace or final refund email) OR 2) if refund posts to your card, we can issue a debit memo to recover; 3) manager approval to adjust the per-diem. Timeline: if refund proof posted within 30 days we will reconcile; if not, we may offset on next reimbursement.
mike (manager): Confirming client canceled second leg and Noah only stayed 2 nights. Approve per-diem adjustment from 3 days to 2 days. Approve reconciling refund per finance policy.
noah kim: thanks Mike. Quick Q: if finance offsets the refund against future expenses, how will I see it? Will there be a line in the reimbursement?
nana (finance): Good question. If we offset, you'll see a negative line item on your next reimbursement statement ("Refund recovery - EUR 215") and an explanation. If you'd rather repay now, we can invoice you or accept a bank transfer. Which do you prefer?
noah kim: offset is fine. Also If9m short on cash this week 614 so please don't invoice me now.
sarah (travel-ops): Re per-diem, please upload the updated travel calendar/itinerary showing the two overnight dates so finance can update the claim.
noah kim: uploaded itinerary_2nights.ics and updated the Expensify expense note to "2 nights stay; partial refund pending."
nana (finance): Received itinerary. Marking ticket FIN-9733. We'll adjust per-diem and apply the refund recovery on your next reimbursement. Expect reconciliation note in 30 days or earlier when bank posts. If refund posts to the corpcard instead, we'll mark as recovered and close FIN-9733.
noah kim: appreciate it. One last thing 64f the refund email shows EUR but my bank posts in USD sometimes; will FX differences be reconciled?
nana (finance): Yes we'll reconcile FX. If the refund posts in USD and amount differs due to FX, we'll net the actual posted value. Small rounding differences under $5 are absorbed by Finance; larger deltas will be discussed with you.
expense-bot: FIN-9733 created. Reminder: attach bank proof within 30 days to avoid auto-offset.
noah kim: got it. thanks everyone 60a
